items.igCaption:
BuzzFeed Studios and MuVpix to produce over 100 microdramas.

BuzzFeed Studios and MuVpix have partnered for over 100 microdrama titles in the next two years. Their first project is 'Romeo & Juliet, Reimagined,' a modern retelling set in LA's criminal underworld, launching in August.

Are you excited for this modern Romeo & Juliet reinvention or sticking to the classic version?

AI-assisted recap by The Screen Report.

#MovieNews #Hollywood #RomeoAndJuliet #Microdrama
items.firstComment: This modern LA underworld Romeo & Juliet is the bold reimagining we need — it will set a new standard for inclusive digital storytelling.
